480:t_020:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I have a report to make to $$アウストラリス$$, so I'll leave the rest to you.」

480:t_021:0.en:
$$葵$$
「She went home without even saying goodbye to $$ランド$$.」

480:t_021:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「That just shows how hard your hit landed.」

480:t_021:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That is not it, $$ランド・トラビス$$! Lady $$エルーナ$$ has lost interest in you!」

480:t_021:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! Do you mean to brush aside Lady $$エルーナ$$'s kindness?!」

480:t_021:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then what the hell am I supposed to do?!」

480:t_021:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Fall to me here! That is your destiny!」

480:t_021:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Would you stop getting all worked up on your own, $$ダバラーン$$?」

480:t_021:8.en:
$$くらら$$
「Sorry, but today we're the stars of the show.」

480:t_021:10.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So then, kindly become the rust on the $$断空剣$$.」

480:t_021:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Th-This aura...! It's just like Lady $$エルーナ$$...」

480:t_021:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right? So $$葵$$ will be your opponent.」

480:t_021:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Grrr, come at me! I will prove that someone like you can't hold a candle to Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

480:t_021:16.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Go, $$葵$$! Take down the enemy commander $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ and settle this fight!」

480:t_022:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Grrr! I have a mission to deliver Lady $$エルーナ$$ to $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

480:t_022:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Lady $$エルーナ$$! I am on my way to you now!」

480:t_023:0.en:
$$朔哉$$
「...Geez. He could just admit he lost.」

480:t_023:1.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「It must be his pride and his longing for $$エルーナルーナ$$ all mixed together.」

480:t_023:2.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「He has a cute side, that man.」

480:t_023:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Is that how it works, huh?」

480:t_024:1.en:
$$葵$$
(Thank you, Senpai... Thanks to you, we... won...)

480:t_024:2.en:
$$葵$$
(Maybe now I'm a little closer to Senpai...)

480:t_024:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Splendid work, everyone on $$チームＤ$$. As expected of the strongest team ever, you are members truly worthy of inheriting the name $$ダンクーガ$$.」

480:t_025:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「So you noticed I was here, $$マーズ$$.」

480:t_025:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Last time you said you'd bring the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ with you!」

480:t_025:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「He is not the one who will come. Instead, I will guide you to him.」

480:t_025:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Blood of the beast...」

480:t_025:9.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「...Through the meeting of waters, the course of the winds, the civilization of fire, and then the radiance of the sun, humanity walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

480:t_025:10.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「But your destination is not the radiance of the sun. It is pitch-black darkness.」

480:t_026:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「$$マーズ$$... and $c. I invite you into the darkness.」

480:t_027:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's keep gunning it like this, $$ガンレオン$$!」

480:t_028:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Not bad! Beating the elite of $$ハイアデス$$!」

480:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just so you know, this isn't over! You're next!」

480:t_028:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm so happy, Darling! Looks like you're finally in the mood!」

480:t_028:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! I'll shut that big mouth of yours right now!」

480:t_029:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Damn it! The elite of $$ハイアデス$$ have fallen!」

480:t_029:1.en:
$$葵$$
「You wait, $$ダバラーン$$! You're next!」

480:t_029:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Not so fast! Do not underestimate the power of $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, right hand of Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

480:t_100:0.en:
$$葵$$
(What is this...? This heat in my body... It's like when I went to $$パラダイムシティ$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$...)

480:t_100:1.en:
$$葵$$
(What's happening to me...? Could this be... the influence of the $$ゲッター線$$...?)

480:t_101:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Thanks for waiting, Darling! Let's have plenty of fun!」

480:t_101:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Listen, $$エルーナルーナ$$! If you're a human and not just a beast, then listen properly when people talk to you!」

480:t_101:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Beast, human, who cares. I just do what I want to do, when I want to, as much as I want to!」

480:t_101:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's fine, Darling! You become a beast too and let's enjoy this to the fullest!」

480:t_101:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「A death match of the golden ox and the lion! It's the best!」

480:t_102:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「How've you been, $n! Let me test how much stronger you've gotten since then!」

480:t_102:1.en:
$n
「So you're targeting me too, not just $$ランド$$!」

480:t_102:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry, no~! Believe it or not, I'm a devoted woman.」

480:t_102:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「$$アムブリエル$$ will be your opponent! So today is just a taste!」

480:t_102:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You'd better give up already. That girl will fuse soon, and Miss $$スズネ$$, the one you like so much, will vanish completely.」

480:t_102:6.en:
$n
「I won't let that happen...! No way I'll let it!」

480:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「If it has come to this, then $$ダバラーン$$ will fulfill His Majesty's imperial command in place of Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

480:t_103:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even $$エルーナルーナ$$ couldn't win, so you think you can do it?!」

480:t_103:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I will do it! For Lady $$エルーナ$$'s sake too!」

480:t_103:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't hate guys who go all out for the woman they love like that!」

480:t_103:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「But listen! I show no mercy to anyone who drags other people into a fight for that!」

480:t_103:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Here I come, $$ダバラーン$$! I'm fighting with the power of love today too!」

480:t_103:6.en:
$$葵$$
「And I will cut down that evil space! With the shining fang I inherited from Senpai!!」

480:t_104:0.en:
$$葵$$
(Let's do this, Senpai...! We will inherit the name of $$ダンクーガ$$!)
